title: Initial emitter configuration
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $s$, the emitter configuration with input $w$, state $0$, input-head count $0$, counter-head position $0$, and empty output equals the one-tape seam configuration on input $w$ with state $0$ and tape word $s$.
replaced:
The one-tape payload emitter's starting configuration equals the canonical
word-seam configuration carrying the candidate on its single tape.
